Description: Login failures have increased. Token validation errors are appearing, while identity-provider latency remains normal.
Newly issued tokens fail validation after a signing-key rotation. Older sessions continue to work, and provider connectivity is healthy.
Error: Token signing key identifier is not present in the accepted key set.

Description: All browser sign-ins fail following an authentication configuration deployment. Requests reach the identity provider and return promptly.
Error: Token audience does not match the configured application audience.

Description: Sign-in requests stall for more than ten seconds. Both login requests and health probes to the identity provider show elevated latency.
Error: Identity-provider request timed out after 10000 ms.

Description: Users sign in successfully but are immediately sent back to the login page. The issue occurs only behind a recently added proxy.
Error: Session cookie missing on the authentication callback request.

Description: One user is unable to sign in after repeatedly entering an incorrect password. Other users in the same organization can sign in.
Error: Account temporarily locked after repeated failed login attempts.

Description: Tokens are rejected only by instances on one host. The host clock is several minutes ahead of the identity provider.
Error: Token rejected because its expiration time is earlier than the validator's current time.

Description: Password-reset links are delivered but are rejected immediately for newly requested resets. Ordinary password-based sign-in continues to work.
Users can complete the password step, but multi-factor verification codes are not arriving. The delivery provider is returning service errors.
Error: Multi-factor message delivery failed: provider HTTP 503.

Description: Single sign-on fails for one organization after its application URL changed. Other organizations can still sign in.
Error: Redirect URI does not match a registered callback URI.

Description: Sign-ins succeed, but users cannot access pages they previously had permission to view. Role claims are missing from newly issued tokens.
Error: HTTP 403: required application role claim is missing.

Description: Authentication failures rise during the morning login peak. The identity provider returns rate-limit responses rather than timing out.
One region cannot retrieve the identity provider's discovery document. Database access and general network connectivity are working.
Error: TLS handshake failed while loading identity-provider discovery metadata.

Description: Several users report being logged out unexpectedly. There is no confirmed start time, browser pattern, or server-side error yet.
Existing users can sign in, but newly provisioned users are rejected. The account synchronization job has not completed since yesterday.
Error: User record not found in the application's account directory.
